text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be in good health both mentally and physically. 2. Applicants must be citizens of countries other than the People's Republic of China, and the conditions set by the Document No.12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC should be met. Note: lf the applicant is confirmed to have Chinese nationality by the Chinese public security organs after application, admission, and registration, College of International Education (ClE) reserves the right to withdraw the applicant. 3. Applicants must hold a high school diploma or above. 4. Applicants must be under the age of 30. 5. English-taught programs: There is no requirement for applicants' Chinese proficiency. Applicants should have an Academic lELTS>6.0 (no subtest lower than 5.5), or TOEFL (iBT) >80. Or other authorized equivalent standards of English proficiency. If the language of instruction for compulsory courses in the applicant’s previous degree program was English, the applicant can provide the English language instruction certificate issued by the previous degree institution. 6. China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) score report, for the required test subjects for each undergraduate major, please download here .
